LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Darksteel.nodes.0.label: Tempered Blacksteel
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Darksteel.nodes.0.descrip: Advance while wearing Blacksteel Talons. Retains steel growth, diminishing returns, health, defense and awakening without granting duplicate base stats or steel marks. Progression stays with the item; unequipping stops its effects.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Darksteel.nodes.1.label: Scored Reprisal
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Darksteel.nodes.1.descrip: After an enemy primary hit actually injures you, mark that attacker for 5 seconds, once per 8 seconds. Your later ordinary hit on that enemy consumes the mark for 50 damage. One mark at a time. Fully shielded hits, friendly fire and secondary damage do not count. Base rewards: damage 50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Darksteel.nodes.2.label: Armored Escort
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Darksteel.nodes.2.descrip: After an enemy primary hit actually injures you, shield the nearest other eligible colonist within 4 cells and clear sight for 50 base points over 3 seconds, once per 8 seconds. Fully absorbed hits do not count. Does not shield you instead. Base rewards: shield 50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Darksteel.nodes.3.label: Splintered Reprisal
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Darksteel.nodes.3.descrip: After Scored Reprisal actually deals its bonus damage, strike one other enemy within 3 cells of the impact and clear sight for 25 damage, once per 8 seconds. Never strikes the original target again. Base rewards: damage 25.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Darksteel.nodes.4.label: Reforged Recovery
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Darksteel.nodes.4.descrip: After Scored Reprisal actually deals its bonus damage, heal 20 base points of your recoverable injuries, once per 8 seconds. Fully prevented bonus damage grants nothing. Does not restore permanent scars or missing parts. Base rewards: healing 20.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Darksteel.nodes.5.label: Armored Relief
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Darksteel.nodes.5.descrip: After an enemy primary hit actually injures you, heal 20 base points of recoverable injuries on the most injured other eligible colonist within 4 cells and clear sight, once per 8 seconds. Selects its patient independently from Armored Escort. Does not heal you instead. Base rewards: healing 20.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Darksteel.nodes.6.label: Armored Advance
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Darksteel.nodes.6.descrip: An ordinary hit records your position. Move at least 3 cells and land another ordinary hit within 3 seconds to gain a separate 2-base-point shield for 3 seconds, once per 8 seconds. The first hit only records position; later eligible hits update it. Base rewards: shield 50.
